id: title:Gilbert09:explain the stripe webhook endpoint limit error

review.posthog_relevance: Stripe warehouse connector recovery and user guidance
review.reason: Adds Stripe-specific webhook endpoint limit detection and recovery messaging. P1.F1.H1 introduces the helper to identify Stripe account-wide webhook limits; P1.F1.H2 applies this check to return a user-friendly error and recovery steps instead of raw exceptions; P1.F2.H1 provides regression tests for this behavior. This represents a bounded, substantive improvement in the Stripe DW
review.uncertainty: Exact behavior cannot be fully verified without the Stripe library dependency and complete execution path; unverified outcomes include actual account-wide limit enforcement and recovery success.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the Stripe library dependency or the stripe_lib module definition, so the exact behavior of the mocked InvalidRequestError and the complete execution path cannot be fully verified. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function _is_stripe_webhook_limit_error that checks if an error string contains the phrases 'maximum of' and 'webhook endpoint'.
observations.code_quote: return "maximum of" in lowered and "webhook endpoint" in lowered
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog's Stripe warehouse connector to distinguish Stripe account-wide webhook endpoint limits from other permission or 403 errors, enabling a specific recovery message instead of raw Stripe errors.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check in create_webhook that calls the new helper and returns a WebhookCreationResult with a success=False and a user-facing error message explaining the webhook endpoint limit and recovery steps.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the behavior of the Stripe warehouse connector to provide actionable guidance when a Stripe account hits its webhook endpoint cap, rather than potentially confusing raw error messages.

observations.behavior: Adds a regression test class and a test case that mocks a Stripe client returning an InvalidRequestError with the specific webhook limit message, asserting that the connector returns success=False and an error message containing 'webhook endpoint limit' and 'manually'.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides test coverage for the new webhook limit detection and recovery message, ensuring the connector behaves correctly when Stripe returns the account-wide limit error.
